name: Íth

attributes.attribute: the first Milesian to glimpse Ireland across the sea
killed by the Tuatha Dé Danann after he landed
nephew of Íth who avenged his death
led the Milesians in a successful invasion

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Íth was an Irish hero in the Book of Invasions. He was a Milesian, and the first of them to glimpse Ireland across the sea. He guided a band of kin to the island. The magical Tuatha Dé Danann slew him soon after. They already ruled the land. His nephew Míl Despaine repaid the slaying. Then Míl led the Milesians into Ireland and won the land.
